mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, message, remind_time, timezone, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM reminders WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, title, message, remind_time, timezone, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM reminders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY remind_time ASC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, message, remind_time, timezone, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM reminders WHERE enabled = 1
